data.raw_text:
Pixels AMA Summary 

This one felt less like hype and more like a reality check on where the game is heading. A lot of the focus was on sustainability, new monetization, and making the ecosystem work long term instead of chasing short-term excitement. @pixels_online 

Here’s the breakdown 👇
-----------------------------------------------------------

🌱 Lily of the Valley Event (Live Now)

A new 20-day event is active right now. Players collect seeds, grow lilies, craft offerings, and turn them in for Lily Coins.

🐝 30 new Bee NFT pets can now be minted through pet capsules until June 15
🎆 25 limited Lily Glow Sticks are available with special particle aura effects
⚡ Lily Charms give temporary 20% boosts to farming, mining, forestry, and animal care — and yes, they stack
📅 Finish 70 offerings before May 26 to complete the full event questline
🪙 Stacked-related tasks during the event will reward extra Lily Coins

You can access the event through the portal in Terra Villa Central.
-----------------------------------------------------------

💳 Economy & Payment Changes

This is probably the biggest long-term shift the team talked about.

💵 Core Pixels will soon support regular payment methods like credit cards and GCash
🔄 Most earning systems are being moved into Stacked instead of the main game
🏦 Stacked points are planned to become both spendable in-game and cash-out compatible
🟢 Foundation staking rewards are gradually moving toward USDC rewards instead of only PIXEL
📢 The team wants to use platforms like Meta, Google, and TikTok ads to bring in completely new players without forcing them into crypto first

The idea is pretty simple: reduce crypto friction, grow the audience, then slowly introduce players to the ecosystem later.
-----------------------------------------------------------

📊 Sustainability Update

The team shared actual economy numbers this time, which honestly was more interesting than vague optimism.

📈 The game reportedly generated around 3.5x return on reward spending over the last month
🔥 For every 1 PIXEL distributed, roughly 3.5 PIXEL worth of value came back into the system
♻️ That creates a net burn effect inside the closed economy loop
🕒 According to the team, Pixels has operated sustainably for about six months now

They also admitted external token pressure still exists from investor and advisor emissions, so the next goal is building stronger revenue sources outside speculation.
-----------------------------------------------------------

🎮 Chubkins Update

The mobile mini-game collection is already in early access on Google Play, and the next update sounds much bigger.

👾 New monsters and sticker systems are coming in the next release
🛠️ A large UX and optimization pass is planned before wider expansion
🌏 The Philippines is likely the next rollout region
🎁 Chubkins already connects directly into Stacked rewards
🤝 The team is also testing co-op earning mechanics

-----------------------------------------------------------

⭐ VIP System Rework (Early June)
VIP is getting rebuilt to feel less punishing for newer or smaller spenders.

🪜 A new beginner tier will be added below the current Tier 1
💎 A new Tier 6 is being introduced for heavy spenders
🎫 One-month VIP coupons will finally become available

🚀 Longer subscriptions instantly boost your starting tier:
• 3 months = Tier 2
• 6 months = Tier 4
• 12 months = Tier 6

Current VIP holders will keep equivalent benefits after the restructure.
-----------------------------------------------------------

⛓️ Ronin Migration Reminder

Ronin migrates to Ethereum on May 12 at 3 PM UTC, and downtime is expected for around 10 hours.
🚫 PIXEL deposits and withdrawals will pause across Pixels, Stacked, staking, and dungeons
🏝️ NFT land ownership updates may temporarily lag behind
🧩 Avatar switching and guild shard trading will not function during migration
🔒 Swaps, staking actions, and NFT trades will all be unavailable until migration finishes
-----------------------------------------------------------
🎯 Bigger Picture

Luke was unusually blunt during this AMA. The team seems very aware that most Web3 games still haven’t reached mainstream-level appeal.

🧠 Team's focus now is scaling sustainably instead of maintaining a small crypto-native player base
📉 The team openly acknowledged that many normal gamers dislike crypto onboarding and wallets
🤖 Stacked’s AI-driven game economist system is being designed to reduce pointless grinding and improve retention
⚔️ Pixel Dungeons is still alive, though the team admitted crypto-heavy multiplayer games are difficult to scale efficiently
🌍 The long-term goal is making play-to-earn feel normal and genuinely sustainable instead of temporary hype cycles
-----------------------------------------------------------

Overall, this AMA felt less like “huge announcements” and more like the team trying to prove the business can actually survive long term. Honestly, probably one of the more important AMAs they’ve done in a while.
